_help: Each case is a chain of scramble steps. The last step is the diagnosis.

cases.title: Crushing Chest Pain
cases.presentation: A 58-year-old man who smokes has had 40 minutes of crushing central chest pain radiating to his left arm, with sweating and nausea.

steps.clue: His pain comes from heart muscle starved of blood flow. Name the process.
steps.definition: Inadequate blood supply to a tissue, causing oxygen shortage.
steps.explanation: Myocardial ischemia causes the pressure-like pain of angina and infarction.

steps.clue: The first test to perform within 10 minutes of his arrival
steps.definition: A recording of the heart's electrical activity.
steps.explanation: A 12-lead ECG quickly identifies ST-elevation MI, which needs immediate reperfusion.

steps.clue: Cardiac protein measured in blood to confirm heart muscle injury
steps.definition: A cardiac muscle protein released into the blood when heart cells are damaged.
steps.explanation: A rise and fall of troponin confirms myocardial injury.

steps.clue: ST elevation and raised troponin: myocardial ____
steps.definition: Death of tissue caused by an interrupted blood supply.
steps.explanation: Diagnosis: ST-elevation myocardial infarction. Treat with urgent PCI, plus aspirin and a second antiplatelet.

cases.title: The Thirsty Teenager
cases.presentation: A 16-year-old girl has had two weeks of extreme thirst, passing lots of urine and weight loss. Today she is vomiting, drowsy and breathing deeply.

steps.clue: The medical term for passing large volumes of urine
steps.definition: Passing abnormally large volumes of urine.
steps.explanation: High glucose spills into urine and pulls water with it (osmotic diuresis).

steps.clue: These are strongly positive in her blood and give her breath a fruity smell
steps.definition: Acidic molecules made when the body breaks down fat for fuel.
steps.explanation: Without insulin, fat is broken down, producing ketones.

steps.clue: Her venous pH is 7.1. Name this state.
steps.definition: An excess of acid in the body fluids, lowering blood pH.
steps.explanation: Ketones cause a high anion gap metabolic acidosis. Deep Kussmaul breathing blows off CO2 to compensate.

steps.clue: New type 1 diabetes presenting as diabetic ____
steps.definition: A life-threatening state of high ketones, acidosis and usually high glucose.
steps.explanation: Diagnosis: diabetic ketoacidosis. Treat with IV fluids, fixed-rate insulin and careful potassium replacement.

cases.title: Fever and a Stiff Neck
cases.presentation: A 19-year-old student has a high fever, severe headache and vomiting. Light hurts her eyes, her neck is stiff, and purple spots are appearing on her legs.

steps.clue: The term for her discomfort with light
steps.definition: Abnormal sensitivity or discomfort on exposure to light.
steps.explanation: Photophobia, headache and neck stiffness suggest meningeal irritation.

steps.clue: Tiny purple spots that do not fade under a pressed glass
steps.definition: Pinpoint, non-blanching spots from bleeding under the skin.
steps.explanation: A non-blanching rash with fever suggests meningococcal sepsis.

steps.clue: The gram-negative diplococcus most likely responsible
steps.explanation: It spreads by droplets and can kill within hours. Close contacts need prophylaxis.

steps.definition: Inflammation of the membranes covering the brain and spinal cord.
steps.explanation: Diagnosis: bacterial meningitis. Give IV ceftriaxone immediately and do not delay for a lumbar puncture.
